pictures.author: V. Vasant
pictures.observations: Whole480x640 front exterior: pale raised platform/treads, blue columns with square bases/molded capitals/cream-gold-green painted bands, deep blue projecting beam/canopy undersides. Two shallow red domes/ornate red parapets and taller curvilinear red shikhara behind. Original small petal/lobe vocabulary; no copied deity/inscription imagery.

pictures.author: Rashmi.parab
pictures.observations: Whole500x667 current complete load: two front blue supports on pale masonry cheek blocks frame actual broad treads, black-white patterned occupied paving. Open blue hall has gold/green collars/capitals and horizontal canopy slabs, pale closed shrine wall/door behind, two red domes and red clustered curved tower/finials. Low metal queue barriers; omit visitors, trees, unreadable signs and temporary/festival coverings.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Specific Brahma Temple Pushkar exterior: red curvilinear ribbed shikhara with stepped attached minor spires/finial, pale closed rear shrine/door behind open blue-column mandapa, two shallow red domes and red lobed parapets. Molded blue supports/original cream-gold-green petal bands, projecting blue front canopy, broad actual treads/pale cheek blocks and occupied checked platform. Map-shaped pale low entrance-side annexes retain the full temple footprint; unseen roof/door detail remains simplified. The mapped adjoining pale courtyard gallery is included as a low flat-topped envelope with original simple court arches; unseen outer rooms remain simplified. Independent market/court buildings, trees, people/festival covers/signs and furnished ritual interior are not authored.
